# DereksDetailing

## Derek's Detailing | Manchester NH
Source: https://derekverbrugge.github.io/DereksDetailing/

Manchester, New Hampshire · Hand-finished detailing
Clean finish.
Clear pricing.
Clearer headlights, cleaner glass, and a finish you can see clearly. I offer headlight restoration, careful clear-coat scratch reduction, hand washing, 3D Bead It Up ceramic spray protection, and interior surface care—all finished by hand with Chemical Guys and 3D Car Care products. For the optional $25 premium finish, I use TEC582 as a drying aid on the freshly washed, still-damp exterior; it helps the drying towel glide while laying down ceramic spray protection. I use Rain-X water-repellent glass treatments that help rain, salt spray, and road grime shed more easily from treated glass in wet and winter driving.
Headlight restoration and scratch reduction depends on lense thickness and clear-coat condition, and complete restoration or removal cannot be guaranteed. Services are subject to vehicle inspection.

Our services
Exterior packages
Every exterior package includes hand washing, 3D Bead It Up ceramic spray protection, and cleaning of accessible wheels and exterior brake components without disassembly. Add TEC582 for $25 on any vehicle: I apply it as a drying aid to the clean, damp exterior while towel-drying, then top it with 3D Bead It Up for a glossy finish. 3D Bead It Up typically provides about 3 months of protection, while TEC582 provides about 6 months. Actual longevity varies with weather, washing, and vehicle use. This is an optional upgrade, not a replacement for the standard finish.

Rain-X water-repellent glass treatment helps rain bead and roll off exterior glass and makes salt spray and road grime easier to clear during winter driving. It does not melt ice or replace winter washer fluid. Glass is cleaned before application; results vary with conditions and use.
Interior surface detail covers dashboard, console, door panels and compatible hard surfaces;
excludes floors, carpets, vacuuming, upholstery extraction and deep seat cleaning.
